title: Your cosmetics collection
summary: Browse the cosmetics collection in game and manage your equipment on the website.
body:
- Open /cosmetics to discover badges, trails, emotes, victory effects, profile frames, lobby flight and arrival effects. Bedrock players use native forms.
- Equip owned cosmetics and preview your emote or victory effect in the lobby. Subscription effects stop when access expires.
- Lobby flight hands control safely to Skyblock and minigame loading protection.
- Use /support link to connect your Minecraft account to the website and manage your collection.
